column1: # Rabi-Ribi: CreSpirit's 2D engine on NVN, SDK 7.4.0; modules main + subsdk0 (GLSLC, NVN's runtime shader compiler) + subsdk1 (NintendoSDK_movie) + sdk.
# RomFS: PNG and Ogg art under pack/, area maps and fonts under data/, translations under localize/. No game file holds the shaders: main holds 5 GLSL sources and calls
# glslcCompile in subsdk0, so the game compiles them with its own GLSLC at run time (as Three Houses' 9 built-in shaders are). Format: see dm/games/README.md
# the update NSP is v131072; the extracted version dir is v1 (display version 1.2.0 from the control data)
# the NPDM declares no system resource (META +0x14 = 0): the game uses SetHeapSize (main sets a heap of at most the pool - 64 MB: a 3328 MB heap region)
# a 2D platformer played with a controller; no touch or pointer input
# The game's shaders are compiled at run time with its own GLSLC (main holds GLSL sources, glslcCompile is in subsdk0): the NSP script captures the outputs on the Mac with
# DM_GLSLC_CAPTURE=<version dir>/glslc_capture (hle_glslc.c), and shader_split.py reads them like any other GLSLC output.
